name: TanStack Query
covers: Rerail's own TanStack Query rules, from the TanStack docs and maintainers' advice, for query data read from the query instead of copied into state, query functions that throw on a failed response, and one query function per query key.

rules.title: TanStack Query practice: read query data from the query, never copy it into useState
TanStack Query practice: a queryFn or mutationFn that calls fetch() throws when the response is not ok
TanStack Query practice: one query key, one query function
